findingVerification.notes: The benchmark warden.toml explicitly sets defaults.verification.enabled = true.

traceCapture.notes: Run used --traces on all six clean shards. Raw JSONL artifacts are withheld pending sensitive-data review; committed traceSummaries retain sanitized per-chunk metadata only.

timing.notes: Six shards completed sequentially at standard parallelism 4 without repairs.

scoring.notes: Agent-verified semantic matches. A finding counts when it identifies the same bug in roughly the same location at the same corpus commit. Same-file findings about different bugs do not count; one finding can map to multiple corpus IDs.

scores.notes: Real cleartext credential logging, but this commit's corpus entry covers the allowlist tuple bug.
Internal EA features are reachable without the intended org:admin check.
client_secret_jwt omits exp and outlives the short jti replay cache.
Bitbucket Server accepts unsigned public webhook events.
Workflow-backed alert deletion is organization-scoped instead of project-scoped.
Concrete timing-unsafe secret comparison, not the Statsig timestamp-freshness corpus bug.
Statsig signatures do not enforce timestamp freshness.
Release webhook tokens use predictable uuid1 material.
The shared Atlassian JWT helper trusts the unverified alg header.
The returned token is Fernet-encrypted for Seer; the claimed credential exposure is not established.
Plausible unmetered telemetry-query abuse, not the project-access corpus bug.
Legacy Jira requests disable TLS verification while sending Basic Auth.
Separate JQL injection through a configurable project key, not the autocomplete escaping corpus bug.
Organization-level Seer methods expose project-backed data without project access checks.
Mobile-build metadata reaches an unescaped ECharts HTML tooltip.
Copy-as-curl leaves HTTP methods and header names unescaped.
Read-scoped organization members can rotate Codecov repository tokens.
Untrusted Atlassian alg selection is a separate issue; this commit's corpus entry covers iss/body binding.
External-team lookup is organization-scoped and permits cross-team mutation.
Real accept-invite deletion flaw, but this commit's corpus entry covers shared-issue slug confusion.
An unverified notification payload can trigger arbitrary GCS transfer jobs.
System-options PUT logs cleartext credential values.
